title: Identification and expression analysis of SBP-Box-like (SPL) gene family disclose their contribution to abiotic stress and flower budding in pigeon pea (Cajanus cajan).
authors: Shaheen, Tayyaba; Rehman, Abdul; Abeed, Amany H A; Waqas, Muhammad; Aslam, Asad; Azeem, Farrukh; Qasim, Muhammad; Afzal, Muhammad; Azhar, Muhammad Farooq; Attia, Kotb A; Abushady, Asmaa M; Ercisli, Sezai; Nahid, Nazia
one_liner_zh: 该文鉴定木豆SPL转录因子家族并分析其表达，仅对两个蛋白与激素配体做分子对接，未涉及蛋白-DNA互作或结合位点预测，方法上仅简单对接，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: The SPL gene family (for Squamosa Promoter-binding like Proteins) represents specific transcription factors that have significant roles in abiotic stress tolerance, development and the growth processes of different plants, including initiation of the leaf, branching and development of shoot and fruits. The SPL gene family has been studied in different plant species; however, its role is not yet fully explored in pigeon pea (Cajanus cajan ). In the present study, 11 members of the CcSPL gene family were identified in C. cajan . The identified SPLs were classified into nine groups based on a phylogenetic analysis involving SPL protein sequences from C. cajan , Arabidopsis thaliana , Cicer arietinum , Glycine max , Phaseolus vulgaris , Vigna unguiculata and Arachis hypogaea . Further, the identification of gene structure, motif analysis, domain analysis and presence of cis -regulatory elements in the SPL family members were studied. Based on RNA-sequencing data, gene expression analysis was performed, revealing that CcSPL2.1, 3 and 13A were significantly upregulated for salt-tolerance and CcSPL14 and 15 were upregulated in a salt-susceptible cultivar. Real-time qPCR validation indicated that CcSPL3, 4, 6 and 13A were upregulated under salt stress conditions. Therefore, molecular docking was performed against the proteins of two highly expressed genes (CcSPL3 and CcSPL14 ) with three ligands: abscisic acid, gibberellic acid and indole-3-acetic acid. Afterward, their binding affinity was obtained and three-dimensional structures were predicted. In the future, our study may open avenues for harnessing CcSPL genes in pigeon pea for enhanced abiotic stress resistance and developmental traits.
abstract_zh: SPL基因家族（Squamosa Promoter-binding like Proteins）代表一类特异性转录因子，在非生物胁迫耐受性、发育以及不同植物的生长过程中（包括叶片起始、分枝以及茎和果实的发育）发挥重要作用。SPL基因家族已在多种植物物种中进行了研究；然而，其在木豆（Cajanus cajan）中的作用尚未被充分探索。在本研究中，从C. cajan中鉴定出11个CcSPL基因家族成员。基于涉及C. cajan、拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）、鹰嘴豆（Cicer arietinum）、大豆（Glycine max）、菜豆（Phaseolus vulgaris）、豇豆（Vigna unguiculata）和花生（Arachis hypogaea）的SPL蛋白序列的系统发育分析，将所鉴定的SPLs分为九组。此外，还研究了SPL家族成员中的基因结构鉴定、基序分析、结构域分析以及顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements）的存在情况。基于RNA测序数据，进行了基因表达分析，结果显示CcSPL2.1、3和13A在耐盐品种中显著上调，而CcSPL14和15在盐敏感品种中上调。实时qPCR验证表明，CcSPL3、4、6和13A在盐胁迫条件下上调。因此，针对两个高表达基因（CcSPL3和CcSPL14）的蛋白，与三种配体（脱落酸、赤霉素和吲哚-3-乙酸）进行了分子对接。随后，获得了它们的结合亲和力，并预测了三维结构。未来，我们的研究可能为利用木豆中的CcSPL基因增强非生物胁迫抗性和发育性状开辟途径。
